thread:
Alex (AE): Hey team—Crescent Fin POC kickoff. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM user/group provisioning, RBAC scoped by domain, and domain ownership verification. Also want pricing for Dedicated capacity and an ETA for security questionnaire answers.
Maria (SE): Got it. Do we have their IdP type?
Tony (Crescent Fin): We're on Okta (orgwide), multiple domains (crescent.com + partners.crescent.com). Prefer SP-initiated SSO.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Okta SP-initiated is straightforward. We need: ACS URL, EntityID, and metadata. Also confirm NameID format—email vs persistent. For RBAC: do they want role claims from the IdP or mapped via SCIM groups?
Tony (Crescent Fin): Prefer groups from SCIM for role mapping. We push group membership from Okta.
Maria (SE): SCIM push is supported. Two notes: 1) we currently implement full-sync + incremental provisioning (PATCH). 2) Group size >10k might need pagination tuning.
Sylvie (Security): We'll need their ADFS/Okta SAML metadata. Also: certificate rotation policy, SCIM over TLS, and proof of domain ownership (DNS TXT or verification email). Any regulatory constraints?
Tony (Crescent Fin): No heavy regs for this team, but internal policy requires cert rotation every 90 days and tenant isolation. They also enforce domain binding—users with crescent.com must map to tenant A.
Raj (Solutions Eng): For domain binding we can support email domain -> tenant mapping via routing rules. Edge case: users with multiple verified domains in one org? We map to primary domain unless they have org attribute.
Maria (SE): For the POC plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata, 2) enable SCIM with a test Okta app, 3) push groups and verify RBAC mapping, 4) test domain-claim flows. I'll draft a small config snippet:
```
# sample SAML settings
acs_url: https://api.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs
entity_id: https://redwood-inference.com/saml/sp
nameid_format: email
```
Tony (Crescent Fin): That looks right. How long for Dedicated pricing quote?
Alex (AE): I can get a preliminary quote today for a 6‑month reserved pool + estimated token throughput. Expect ballpark in 4 hours.
Sylvie (Security): I'll take the questionnaire. Tony, please upload the vendor security form to the thread or email. I'll annotate and return within 48 hours.
infra-bot: Helpful docs: https://docs.redwood.com/sso/scim and https://docs.redwood.com/dedicated/pricing (links auto-posted)
Raj (Solutions Eng): One more technical nuance: Okta sometimes sends group membership as claims (SAML) vs SCIM delta. We'll test both. If they want SCIM-only, we need to ensure group mapping is idempotent.
Tony (Crescent Fin): We'll start with SCIM push. Also need session timeout control and SSO logout behavior documented.
Maria (SE): Session TTL and single logout supported. I'll include expected cookie/session lifetimes in the POC runbook.
Alex (AE): Action items: Alex -> pricing quote (4h); Maria -> POC runbook + SAML/SCIM checklist; Sylvie -> security review on upload (48h); Raj -> prepare test plan for large-group sync. Tony -> share Okta metadata + questionnaire.
Tony (Crescent Fin): Will share metadata and questionnaire by EOD. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Maria (SE): Great, I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with Crescent Fin for tomorrow.
Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll stand by for the Okta app access.
Alex (AE): Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for updates. :rocket:
